blocks.x: Data & Lakehouse applied to K-12 & School Systems. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

School systems serve every child under public scrutiny: learning analytics, special-education compliance, safeguarding and parental communication. Technology must be privacy-strict (minors), accessibility-complete and teacher-time-respecting.

items: Assessment, attendance and wellbeing data siloed; interventions late.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Enterprise BI & Executive Analytics, Master Data, Governance & Cataloging, Enterprise BI & Executive Analytics from the Data, Analytics & Lakehouse tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Learning analytics, Safeguarding case management, Special-ed compliance) on Dataq Forge and Dataq Nexus. Governance inherits the sector frame — FERPA/GDPR-K among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: One customer, one product, one truth: MDM and catalog discipline that regulators can read.
Forward-looking risk on governed data: credit, insurance, operational and market models that explain themselves.
Turn the data estate into revenue: embedded analytics, data sharing and insight products with real P&L.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Education & Research level this capability reads as: governed research datasets with ethics-aware access control (collaboration without governance loss). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The engagement cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
